source: 605 Lingering Effects
target: 605 Effectus Perstantes

source: Hearing the cries of a baby again?
target: Iterumne audis gemitus infantis?

source: Is he pestered by the so‐called Child of God?
target: Num vexatur ab eo, qui vocatur “Filius Dei”?

source: Lumian held Madam Magician’s reply, unfinished, and adjusted his sitting posture with amusement.
target: Lumian tenuit responsum Dominae Magicae, imperfectum, et sedendi statum se mutavit cum hilaritate.

source: He gazed at the door and said, “Come in.”
target: Ianuam aspexit et dixit: “Ingredere!”

source: Lugano turned the handle and cautiously pushed open the door, uncomfortably stopping in front of Lumian.
target: Lugano manubrium vertit et caute ianuam aperuit, in conspectu Lumiani incommode sistens.

source: His actions and demeanor, combined with his thick eyebrows, large eyes, and square face, made him appear rather comical.
target: Eius actus et habitus, cum crassis superciliis, oculis magnis et facie quadrata, eum ridiculum videbant.

source: “Isn’t that evil Warlock, the old man n‑named Prinpino, already dead?
target: Nonne ille maleficus magus, senex Prinpino nominatus, iam mortuus est?

source: Why can I still hear the cries of a baby?”
target: Cur adhuc audire possum gemitus infantis?

source: Lugano inquired with concern, his tone reflecting it.
target: Lugano anxius quaesivit, eiusque vox curam ostendebat.

source: Having consulted the just‑awakened Ludwig, he had received an answer that he hadn’t heard the baby’s cries.
target: Consulto Ludwig nuper evigilato, responsum accepit quod gemitus infantis non audiverat.

source: Lumian playfully shook the letter in his hand and chuckled.
target: Lumian epistulam in manu sua ludenter concussit et subridens risit.

source: “There are two possibilities.
target: Duae sunt possibilitates.

source: One is that Prinpino’s accomplices on the ship also possess the ritual to summon the Child of God.
target: Una est, ut socii Prinpini in nave ritum quoque habeant ad evocandum Filium Dei.

source: The other possibility is…
target: Altera possibilitas est…

source: Lugano pressed impatiently, “What is it?”
target: Lugano impatiens quaesivit: “Quid est?”

source: Lumian glanced at the Doctor and grinned.
target: Lumian ad Medicum aspexit et subridens.

source: “Perhaps the unborn Child of God has taken a liking to you and wants to choose you as his surrogate mother.
target: Fortasse, infans Dei nondum natus tibi placebat et te eligere vult ut mater vicaria.

source: Thus, even though Prinpino is already dead, he’s unwilling to leave you and continues to linger by your side.
target: Itaque, quamquam Prinpino iam mortuus est, noluit te relinquere et ad te permanet.

source: Normally, he can’t be seen or sensed.
target: Normaliter, eum videre neque sentire licet.

source: Lugano’s scalp tingled as he listened.
target: Dum audiebat, cutis capitis eius formidine pulsabat.

source: Ignoring the question of why he was a mother and not a father, he stammered, “W-what should I do?”
target: Neglexit quaestionem cur mater esset et non pater, et titubans dixit: “Quid agam?”

source: “No rush.”
target: “Nulla festinatio.”

source: Lumian smiled.
target: Lumian subridens.

source: “There’s no need to hurry in such circumstances.”
target: Non opus est festinare in talibus condicionibus.

source: Lugano felt like his internal organs might be devoured by the so‐called Child of God at any moment, leaving only an empty cavity.
target: Lugano sensit quasi organa interna eius ab eo, qui “Filius Dei” dicitur, quovis momento vorari possent, relinquendo solum cavum.

source: “Of course,” Lumian said in a relaxed state.
target: “Certe,” Lumian in statu relaxato dixit.

source: “Aren’t you still alive?”
target: Nonne adhuc vivus es?

source: “Since you’re not dead, it means the situation isn’t very serious.”
target: Cum non mortuus es, id significat rem non esse gravem.

source: “You can take it slow.”
target: Potes lente procedere.

source: “There’s no hurry.”
target: Nulla festinatio est.

source: That seems to be the case…
target: Ita videtur…

source: Lugano, caught up in the conversation, nodded and asked in confusion, “Must I die before the problem becomes serious enough for it to become urgent?”
target: Lugano, sermone captus, annuit et, confusione affectus, quaesivit: “Oportetne me mori, antequam quaestio satis grave fiat ut sit urgetur?”

source: Lumian chuckled and said, “No, it means there’s zero need to rush.”
target: Lumian subridens dixit: “Non, nihil est necessarium festinare.”

source: “If you’re already dead, what’s the hurry?
target: Si iam mortuus es, cur festinas?

source: Can I revive you?”
target: Possumne te revivere?

source: In short, there’s no need to rush?
target: In summa, nihil opus est festinare?

source: Lugano was taken aback.
target: Lugano obstupefactus erat.

source: Though he harbored doubts, his employer’s ability to crack jokes and play pranks reassured him.
target: Quamquam dubitationes habebat, ingenium domini eius iocos et ludibria faciens eum consolavit.

source: Evidently, his employer didn’t view the baby’s cries as a grave concern!
target: Evidenter, dominus eius gemitus infantis non tam gravem rem putabat!

source: Only then did Lumian unveil his true speculation.
target: Tunc solum Lumian veram speculationem suam revelavit.

source: “There’s a third possibility.
target: Tertia possibilitas est.

source: The corruption you suffered upon contact with Enio won’t dissipate so quickly, and it’s highly likely that it won’t vanish naturally.
target: Corrutio, quam passi es in contactu cum Enio, non tam celeriter evanescet, et probabiliter naturaliter non evanescere possit.

source: Consequently, you’ll still form a connection with the unborn Child of God.
target: Consequenter, adhuc nexum cum infante Dei nondum nato constitues.

source: “Then, how do I eliminate the corruption?”
target: Tum, quomodo corruptionem extirpare possum?

source: Lugano accepted this explanation and believed that a solution existed.
target: Lugano hanc explicationem accepit et credidit solutionem exsistere.

source: Lumian didn’t immediately respond to his question.
target: Lumian quaestioni eius statim non respondit.

source: He let Lugano stand in front of him as he perused the rest of Madam Magician’s reply.
target: Permisit Lugano coram se stari, dum reliquum responsum Dominae Magicae perlegit.

source: “Considering your link to the Child of God and the evil god’s angel sealed within you, encountering a member of the School of God’s Descent isn’t a mere coincidence.
target: Considerato nexu tuo cum Filio Dei et malo dei angelo intra te sigillato, conventus cum membro Scholae Descensionis Dei non est mera fortuita casus.

source: “However, your interpreter and guide are of the Planter pathway—that raises other issues.
target: Attamen, interpres et dux tuus ex via Plantatoris sunt—hoc alias quaestiones attulit.

source: It’s only natural for you to encounter matters connected to the Great Mother.
target: Est naturale ut incideris in res quae ad Magnam Matrem pertinent.

source: As for the problem, ponder it and inquire within yourself.
target: Quoad quaestionem, medita et intra te quaere.

source: I won’t spoon‑feed you the answer.
target: Non tibi responsum minutatim tradam.

source: Conspirers need to employ their brains more…
target: Conspiratores amplius cerebra sua adhibere debent.

source: Observing this, Lumian looked up at Lugano without uttering a word.
target: Hoc observans, Lumian in Lugano aspexit, nihil dicens.

source: The Doctor’s body tensed, and a thin layer of sweat trickled down his back.
target: Corpus Medici contractum est, et tenuus stratum sudoris per dorsum eius stillavit.

source: “Is—is there any other problem?” Lugano stammered.
target: “Est—estne alia quaestio?” Lugano titubavit.

source: Lumian reclined in his chair and said contemplatively, “Clearing corruption is an entirely separate course in mysticism.
target: Lumian in sella sua recubuit et meditans dixit: “Expurgatio corruptionis est disciplina omnino separata in mystica.

source: I need to grasp the specifics before providing an answer.
target: Mihi necesse est singula comprehendere antequam responsum praebeam.

source: Having underscored the significance, he inquired, “Have you encountered similar situations before?”
target: Significationem illustrato, quaesivit: “Num antea casus similes experieris?”

source: Like peculiar infant cries, mystical occurrences linked to births, sorcery entwined with mothers, and so forth.
target: Sicut gemitus infantium peculiares, phaenomena mystica nativitatibus connexa, et magia cum matribus implicata, et cetera.

source: Lugano dared not be careless, fearing that if the corruption wasn’t rectified promptly, he might end up as an organless being.
target: Lugano non ausus est neglegere, metuens si corruptio celeriter non corrigatur, ut ens sine internis membris fias.

source: He meticulously sifted through his experiences over the years.
target: Per annos, experientias suas diligenter perscrutatus est.

source: After a moment, he tentatively said, “There’s something I’m not sure if it’s relevant…”
target: Post aliquod tempus, titubans dixit: “Aliquid est, sed non certo scio an pertineat…”

source: It was clear that he was reluctant to discuss the matter.
target: Manifestum erat eum rem disputare noluisse.

source: “How am I supposed to know if it’s relevant if you don’t tell me?”
target: Quomodo sciam an id pertinente sit, nisi mihi dicas?

source: Lumian didn’t care about privacy.
target: Lumian de secretis non curabat.

source: After a brief pause, Lugano cleared his throat and said, “Didn’t I mention that I became a Beyonder by obtaining a friend’s relic?”
target: Post brevem intervallum, Lugano guttur suum purgavit et dixit: “Nonne dixi me Beyonder factum esse, reliquiam amici adipiscens?”

source: “Yes, did you murder that friend?” Lumian inquired deliberately.
target: “Ita, occidisti illum amicum?” Lumian interrogavit deliberanter.

source: Lugano hastily shook his head.
target: Lugano celeriter caput vertit.

source: “No, he committed suicide.”
target: Non, seipsum interfecit.

source: “Suicide?” Lumian raised his eyebrows, finding this matter intriguing.
target: “Suicide?” Lumian superciliis extulit, rem mirabilem reputans.

source: Lugano finally gathered the courage and spilled it out in one go,
target: Lugano tandem animum collegit, et omnia simul effudit,

source: “When I worked as a bounty hunter, I utilized the hidden mountain ranges in the Dariège mountain range for smuggling operations.
target: “Cum mercennarius venator essem, reconditas montium compages in catena Dariège ad contrabandam rem adhibui.

source: I moved things back and forth, making a decent sum.
target: Res transiundas ac reducendas moveram, et decentem pecuniam consecutus sum.

source: I even aided some wanted criminals in escaping overseas.
target: Etiam aliquos sceleratos in trans mare effugiendi causa adiuvavi.

source: Tanko was one of them, but his escape wasn’t from Intis to Feynapotter.
target: Tanko unus ex illis erat, sed eius fuga non ab Intis ad Feynapotter fuit.

source: Instead, he fled from Feynapotter to Intis.
target: Contra, ab Feynapotter ad Intis confugit.

source: Eventually, he discovered a secluded valley deep within the mountain range and built a field of his own.
target: Postremo, invenit vallem secluditam in intimo catenae montium et agrum suum condidit.

source: He cultivated crops, tended to livestock, and kept to himself.
target: Fruges coluit, pecora curavit, et se solum retinuit.

source: I regularly visited, supplying him with essentials like salt, sugar, fabric, and other goods.
target: Eum regulariter visitabam, suppeditans ei rebus essentialibus, ut sal, saccharum, pannum, et alia.

source: In return, Tanko imparted mystic knowledge.
target: In compensatione, Tanko scientiam mysticam tradidit.

source: I never imagined leading an ordinary life, with me out there adventuring and becoming a bounty hunter.
target: Numquam putavi me vitam ordinariam degere, foris versari, et venatorem praedonum fieri.

source: Mysticism held a strong allure for me, and the teachings imparted by Tanko seemed invaluable at times.
target: Mystica mihi alliciebat, et doctrinae ab Tanko traditae aliquando inestimabiles videbantur.

source: Tanko could be an enigma.
target: Tanko enigmatum videbatur.

source: Sometimes, he’d fall into brooding silence, his temper as hard and unyielding as stone, as if wrestling with inner demons.
target: Aliquando in silentium meditabundum incidit, et iracundia eius, dura ac inflexa ut lapis, quasi cum daemonibus internis luctans, apparuit.

source: Other times, he’d be buoyant and loquacious, curious about everything around him.
target: Aliis temporibus, alacer et loquax, de omnibus circum se curiosus, videbatur.

source: Every so often, he’d confess to straying from the Mother’s teachings, descending into the depths of darkness.
target: Interdum confitebatur se a doctrinis Matris deviisse, in tenebras profundas descendens.

source: He’d lament how he drifted further from his true self, suffering the consequences.
target: Lamentabatur quomodo a seipso suo recto longe discessisset, consequentias patiens.

source: Occasionally, he’d voice suspicions about the Church, believing it to be deceptive, claiming the true Mother had departed long ago…
target: Interdum suspiciones de Ecclesia efferebat, eam fallacem putans, dicens veram Matrem pridem discessisse…

source: In that moment, Lugano couldn’t help but draw parallels between Tanko’s cryptic musings and the philosophy of the School of God’s Descent, as recounted by Father Montserrat.
target: Illo momento, Lugano non potuit non trahere comparationes inter arcana Tanko cogitationes et philosophiam Scholae Descensionis Dei, ut a Patre Montserrat enarratum est.

source: Was this encounter a foreshadowing, planted in the past?
target: Num hic congressus praenuntiatio fuit, in praeterito insita?

source: Lugano drew in a deep breath, sensing an ominous shiver down his spine.
target: Lugano halitum profundum traxit, sentiens tremorem ominosum per spinam suam.

source: He rushed out his words.
target: Verba celeriter effudit.

source: “Last autumn, I revisited Tanko.
target: “Praeterita autumno, Tankon iterum visitavi.

source: We sipped his brew and discussed various things beyond the mountain.
target: Potavimus potionem eius et de variis rebus extra montem disseruimus.

source: “Out of the blue, he spilled that he couldn’t endure his decadent, sinful self any longer.
target: “Repente, effudit se non posse amplius suam decadentem et peccatricem naturam ferre.

source: The demon lurking deep within him was gaining control.
target: Daemon, qui alte in eo latebat, imperium adipiscebatur.

source: Tanko wanted to end his life before it consumed him entirely.
target: Tanko vitam suam finire volebat, antequam ille eum omnino voraret.

source: His dying wish? I deliver his stuff to Torres, the capital of Gaia Province, and hand it over to a Church of Earth Mother clergyman, preferably a Blessed.
target: Ultima voluntas eius? Ego res eius ad Torres, caput Provinciae Gaiae, deferam atque tradam sacerdoti Ecclesiae Matris Terrae, optime beato.

source: I pretended to agree, talked him out of it, and thought he had abandoned the idea.
target: Simulavi consentire, eum dissuasi, et credidi eum consilium abiecisse.

source: But the next morning, I found him dead in the field where he’d harvested grain.
target: Sed mane postero eum mortuum in agro, ubi frumentum messerat, inveni.

source: Golden wheat ears sprouted from his body.
target: Auratae spicae tritici ex corpore eius ortae sunt.

source: And, get this, he had several female reproductive organs.
target: Et, ecce, plura organa feminina habebat.

source: I was freaked out.
target: Territus sum.

source: Felt like I was dealing with a monster.
target: Senti me quasi cum monstro agere.

source: Now, for us bounty hunters, a dead monster is a good monster.
target: Nunc, nobis mercennariis venatoribus, monstrum mortuum bonum est.

source: It’s material for a paycheck.
target: Est materia ad mercedem.

source: Summoning courage, I went through Tanko’s things.
target: Fortitudinem colligens, res Tankonis perquisivi.

source: Found a golden blob, like a grain seed, but half the size of a fist, next to him.
target: Inveni globum aureum, quasi semen tritici, sed dimidio pugnus magnitudinis, iuxta eum.

source: Based on Tanko’s mystic know‑how, I suspected this blob was the root of his Beyonder powers.
target: Ex scientia mystica Tankonis, suspicabar hunc globum radicem potentiarum Beyonder eius esse.

source: After much internal wrestling, I debated whether to stick to our agreement and send this relic back to the Church.
target: Post multam internam pugnam, deliberavi utrum pactum nostrum tenere et hanc reliquiam ad Ecclesiam remittere debeam.

source: But in the end, greed got the better of me, and I devoured the blob.
target: Sed tandem avaritia me superavit, et globum voravi.

source: I’m a guilty man.
target: Ego reus sum.

source: Broke my promise.
target: Promissum meum fregi.

source: Hoping the Sun forgives me.
target: Sperans Solem me ignoscere.

source: Lumian listened in silence, a chuckle escaping his lips.
target: Lumian silentio audivit, et subridens risus ex labiis eius effluxit.

source: “You just ate it like that?”
target: “Ita tantum id edisti?”

source: Lugano grinned sheepishly and explained, “Yep, that’s right.
target: Lugano, verecunde subridens, explicavit: “Ita, recte.

source: I only learned potion formulas after becoming a Beyonder and diving into mysticism.
target: Postquam Beyonder factus sum et in mystica immersus, solum formulas pocionum didici.

source: I didn’t want a repeat of that experience, so I got obsessed with buying formulas.
target: Illam experientiam iterare nolui, ergo formulae emendi obsessus sum.

source: “You’re lucky.
target: “Felix es.

source: A few years earlier, and surviving that would’ve been tough.
target: Paucis annis ante, id superare difficile fuisset.

source: We might’ve crossed paths in the Dariège mountain range, you as a monster and me as a monster hunter,” Lumian recalled President Gandalf’s research and mocked Lugano.
target: “Fortasse in catena montium Dariège conveniremus, tu ut monstrum et ego ut venatorem monstrorum,” Lumian investigationes Praesidis Gandalf revocavit et Lugano irridens deridit.

source: Internally, Lumian muttered, “Emperor Roselle was right.”
target: Intus, Lumian murmuravit: “Imperator Roselle recte dixit.”

source: The ignorant are fearless…
target: Ignorantes intrepidi sunt…

source: Something’s obviously off with Tanko.
target: Aliquid manifeste in Tanko aberrat.

source: He probably got tangled with the evil god’s faith, corrupting the Beyonder characteristic he left behind.
target: Forsitan fidem dei mali cepit, et naturam Beyonder, quam reliquit, corruptit.

source: Eating it directly… no wonder you encountered the School of God’s Descent and heard baby cries.
target: Eam directo edendo… non mirum est quod Scholae Descensionis Dei incidisti et gemitus infantium audivisti.

source: Easy to be corrupted and influenced, encountering patients like Enio.
target: Facile est corrumpi et affici, cum patientes ut Enio occurrant.

source: Uneasy, Lugano asked, “Was the Planter ingredient I consumed the root of the problem?”
target: Inquietus, Lugano quaesivit: “An materia Plantatoris quam consumpsi radix huius problematis fuerit?”

source: He had ingested it a year prior, and even advanced.
target: Illam ante annum consumpsit, et iam provectus erat.

source: Was there no resolution to the problem?
target: Num nullam resolutionem ad hoc problema exstitit?

source: Lumian, seemingly avoiding Lugano’s beseeching gaze, feigned deep consideration as he perused the concluding segment of Madam Magician’s response.
target: Lumian, visum implorantem Lugani aspectum vitans, simulavit se profunde meditari, dum partem conclusivam responsionis Dominae Magicae perlegebat.

source: “I’ve pondered your earlier caution and have some theories, but presently, I cannot divulge them to you.”
target: Praeteritam tuam cautelam meditatus sum et nonnullas theorias habeo; sed nunc eas tibi revelare nequeo.

source: “I can only hint that Amon and the person behind Him must have orchestrated something beforehand to divert the Celestial Worthy’s attention from the pertinent issue.”
target: Solum possum insinuare quod Amon et persona post eum aliquid antea composuerint, ut attentionem Caelestis Dignitatis a re pertinentia avertarent.

source: “In essence, this situation seems advantageous for you and the rest of us.”
target: Essentialiter, haec condicio vobis et nobis opportuna videtur.

source: “For now, it’s best to feign ignorance and refrain from delving into it.”
target: Nunc melius est ignorantiam fingere et in eam rem non intrare.

source: “If troubled by infantile cries, seek aid from a clergyman of the Church of Earth Mother.”
target: Si gemitus infantium te perturbat, auxilium a sacerdote Ecclesiae Matris Terrae quaere.

source: Wh… Did Madam Magician anticipate Lugano’s lingering effects in advance?
target: Num Domina Magica praevidebat effectus perstantes Lugani?

source: It seems so.
target: Ita videtur.

source: She could discern the root cause of Lugano’s plight…
target: Illa radicem causam Lugani infortunii discerere potuit.

source: Lumian looked up, offering Lugano a reassuring smile.
target: Lumian aspexit et Lugano solacium praebens, subridens.

source: “The remedy to purge the corruption lies in seeking aid from Father Montserrat.”
target: “Remedium ad corruptionem purgandam in auxilio a Patre Montserrat quaerendo iacet.”

source: That’s it? After all my exposition?
target: Hocne est? Post totam expositionem meam?

source: If there’s truly no alternative, I would’ve taken my chances with the priest…
target: Si vere nulla alternativa esset, fortunam meam cum sacerdote temptavissem.

source: Lugano’s lips twitched as he mustered a strained smile.
target: Labia Lugani contorquebantur, dum difficulter subrideret.

source: “Very well, thank you, sir.”
target: “Optime, gratias tibi ago, domine.”
